subject: Piron
text: Speaking with Piron in the castle throne room prompts him to ask the party to check the bridge's condition.

evidence.quote: Head to the castle thrown room, speak with Piron again, and he'll ask you to check the bridges condition.

subject: Old Cave 6th Floor
text: The Hero must be at or above level 25 to make the 6th floor of the Old Cave accessible.

evidence.quote: At this point Hero should be at or above level 25, thus making the 6th floor of the Old Cave accessible.

subject: treasure hunters shop
text: Entering Grenoble and visiting the treasure hunters shop allows players to accept the miracle gem task.

evidence.quote: Enter Grenoble, go to the treasure hunters shop and accept the "miracle gem" task.

subject: first area
text: Opening the six chests in the first area yields three hi bombs.

evidence.quote: Open the six chests in the first area for three hi bombs, then enter the west door.

subject: west door path
text: Following the path through the west door leads to seven chests, three of which contain equipment.

evidence.quote: Follow the path and open the seven chests along the way. Three of the chests contain equipment, all of which should be equipped immediately.

subject: east door
text: Entering the east door from the first room leads to a chest containing an escape.

evidence.quote: Backtrack to the first room and enter the east door this time. Open the chest for an escape and then go down the rope ladder.

subject: toxic marsh
text: Two chests in the toxic marsh contain an ex magic and an ex potion.

evidence.quote: Open the two chest in the toxic marsh for and ex magic and an ex potion.

subject: toxic marsh
text: Searching one space east and two spaces north of the eastern marsh chest reveals a hidden miracle.

evidence.quote: Then search one space east and two spaces north of the eastern chest for a hidden miracle.

subject: east path
text: Proceeding along the east path leads to four chests containing a plate helm.

evidence.quote: Next proceed along the east path and open the four chests there. Equip the plate helm once you get it, then backtrack to the two chests north of the rope ladder.

subject: rope ladder north chests
text: One of the two chests north of the rope ladder contains a hammer rod.

evidence.quote: One of them contains a hammer rod which you should also be equipped immediately.

subject: downstairs path
text: Six chests along the path down the stairs contain knife shoes and needle heels.

evidence.quote: Next go down the stairs, follow the path, and open the six chests along the way. Equip the knife shoes and needle heels, and then head up stairs.

subject: upstairs area
text: Heading upstairs leads to a chest containing a mind gourd, followed by six more chests to the west.

evidence.quote: Open the chest for a mind gourd and then head west opening six more chests along the way.

subject: toxic marsh
text: Searching the toxic marsh below the westernmost chest reveals a hidden miracle.

evidence.quote: Search the toxic marsh below the western most chest for a hidden miracle.

subject: miracle gem
text: Returning to Grenoble with the miracle gem rewards the party with 5000 gold pieces.

evidence.quote: Return to Grenoble, get your 5000 gold pieces for the miracle gem, rest at the inn, and then warp to Odel.

subject: Arus Cave
text: Arus Cave is reached by walking west of Odel across a bridge and entering the first cave entrance.

evidence.quote: Walk west of Odel across a bridge and enter the first cave entrance you see.

subject: south path
text: Going down the first rope ladder and following the south path leads to three chests containing a glass cap, iron helm, and wind shoes.

evidence.quote: Take the first rope ladder you see down, walk all the way around the south path, and open the three chests along for a glass cap, iron helm, and wind shoes.

subject: north rope ladders
text: Descending two rope ladders to the north leads to a chest containing a half mail.

evidence.quote: Walk north and go down the next two rope ladders to find a chest. Open it for a half mail and then go back up the two ladders.

subject: west chest
text: A chest to the west contains a glass robe.

evidence.quote: Open the chest to the west for a glass robe and then continue walking west.

subject: rope ladder path
text: Descending the rope ladder to the west leads to a chest with a stone cure.

evidence.quote: Go down the rope ladder and open the chest for a stone cure.

subject: south path lower level
text: Descending the ladder south of the stone cure chest leads to two chests containing a quilted silk and a miracle.

evidence.quote: Walk south of the chest, go down the rope ladder, and continue walking south to find two chests. Open them for a quilted silk and a miracle.

subject: east side
text: Entering the cave entrance reached by crossing the bridge heading north and going down two ladders leads to two chests containing an ex potion and a dragon egg.

evidence.quote: Exit the cave and cross the bridge to the east. Walk south and then west. Cross the bridge heading north and enter the cave entrance. Go down both rope ladders and walk around the east side to find two chests. Open them for an ex potion and a dragon egg.

subject: Piron
text: Speaking to Piron in Odel Castle, speaking with him at the broken bridge, and walking to the end of the south path from the middle cave entrance causes the bridge to be fixed.

evidence.quote: Exit the cave and return to Odel. Speak with Piron in the castle thrown room. Then return back to the bridge we just examined and speak with Piron again...Exit the cave and enter through the middle cave entrance to the east. Take the first rope ladder down and walk all the way around to the end of the south path, reaching the end triggers dialogue. After it return to the now fixed bridge and cross it.

subject: north path
text: Crossing the fixed bridge and walking west around the north path leads to two chests with an escape and hi arrows.

evidence.quote: After it return to the now fixed bridge and cross it. Walk west and around the north path to reach two chests. Open them for an escape and hi arrows.

subject: door area
text: Following the southern path downstairs and through the door reveals a chest containing a miracle.

evidence.quote: Next walk all the way around the southern path, take the stairs down, and then enter the door. Open the chest for a miracle and then examine the door to trigger dialogue.

subject: rope ladder east chest
text: Ascending the rope ladder past the door leads to a chest to the east containing a revive.

evidence.quote: After it enter the door, walk around to stairs, and take them up. Go up the rope ladder and open the chest to the east for a revive.

subject: south path
text: Taking the south path past the rope ladder leads to a chest containing an ex potion.

evidence.quote: Walk west past the rope ladder and take the south path to a chest which contains an ex potion.

subject: upper rope ladder chest
text: Climbing up another rope ladder reveals a chest containing another revive before the stairs exiting to Arus.

evidence.quote: Now go up the rope ladder and open another chest for another revive. Go up the next rope ladder and then the stairs to exit the cave. Then enter Arus.

subject: Inn
text: The Inn in Arus costs 50 Gold to rest.

subject: bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf in the house with the old man and old woman yields a hi magic.

evidence.quote: Go west into the house with the old man and old woman. Speak with them, then search the bookshelf for a hi magic.

subject: yellow flower
text: Searching a yellow flower at the northeast corner of the house reveals a hidden mind potion.

evidence.quote: After it walk around to the northeast corner of the house and search a yellow flower there for a hidden mind potion.

subject: east side chest
text: Walking around the east side of the Tower of Grief leads to a chest containing a purple ring.

evidence.quote: Ignore the door at first, walk around the east side, and open the chest for a purple ring which you should equip on one of your characters.

subject: first floor stairs
text: Entering the door and going up the stairs leads to three chests containing a revive, a dragon egg, and a stone cure.

evidence.quote: Now enter the door and go up the stairs. Open the three chests for a revive, dragon egg, and a stone cure.

subject: northeast staircase
text: Taking the northeast stairs up in the room with four staircases leads to two chests containing a revive and a stone cure.

evidence.quote: Now we're in a room with four staircases. Take the northeast one up and open the two chests for another revive and another stone cure.

subject: southwest staircase
text: Going up the southwest stairs leads to two chests containing an ex potion and a hi magic.

evidence.quote: Next go up the southwest stairs and open the two chests there for an ex potion and a hi magic.

subject: top floor chest
text: Going up the stairs between the HP and MP restoring panels leads to a chest containing a miracle.

evidence.quote: Step on the HP and MP restoring panels and then head up the stairs between them. Open the chest for a miracle and then speak to the old man.

subject: lockers
text: Searching the lockers up the east stairs in Shai lab yields a hi magic, hi bomb, ex arrows, and a gloom arrow.

evidence.quote: Enter Shai lab and go up the east stairs. Search the lockers for a hi magic, hi bomb, ex arrows, and a gloom arrow.

subject: Falcon
text: Speaking with the Professor in Shai lab after answering no to the girl's question places the party in the Falcon.

evidence.quote: Speak to the girl next to the lockers and answer "no" to her question. Then speak with the Professor to trigger quite a bit of dialogue. After it we'll be in the Falcon.

subject: locker
text: Searching the locker in Carbis yields a mind potion.

evidence.quote: Search the locker for a mind potion, then go down the stairs, and step on the warp pad.

subject: warp pad girl
text: Speaking to the girl after stepping on the warp pad allows the party to rest for free.

evidence.quote: Speak to the girl to rest for free. Then talk to the professor again.
